
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/cmt/p/23427349" title="发布于 2026-10-24 22:28">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">70后 90后 00后技术人，邀你一起重新出发</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        你还记得上一次在技术社区里，因为别人的一条评论突然想通一个问题，是什么时候吗？现在遇到问题，我们第一反应是问 AI。它回答得很快，也常常是对的。技术博客越来越少有人看，评论区越来越安静，很多写了十几年的作者，慢慢也不写了。所以有人说，AI 时代不需要技术社区了
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/35695/202610/35695-20261024221355056-130275114.png" alt="image" height="1" width="800" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<section class="js_darkmode__1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">作者：姬朋飞</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__1" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible" data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">你还记得上一次在技术社区里，因为别人的一条评论突然想通一个问题，是什么时候吗？</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__2" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">现在遇到问题，我们第一反应是问 AI。它回答得很快，也常常是对的。技术博客越来越少有人看，评论区越来越安静，很多写了十几年的作者，慢慢也不写了。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__3" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">所以有人说，AI 时代不需要技术社区了。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__4" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">我不这么认为。这个问题我想了三年，今天想聊聊我的想法。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__5" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold; visibility: visible">做了十年开源社区，很清楚它的价值</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__6" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">我是姬朋飞，爱獭科技的创始人，一个写了十几年代码的技术人。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__7" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); visibility: visible"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; visibility: visible">2015 年，我写了一个小工具 EasyExcel，想让 Java 开发者处理 Excel 时少受点罪。没想到它后来有了上百万次下载，在 GitHub 上拿到 3.5 万多个 Star。后来我在它的基础上写了 FastExcel，捐给 Apache 软件基金会，就是今天的 Apache Fesod。再后来我做了 Chat2DB，下载量过了百万，有 2.8 万个 Star，近一百个交流群，十几万人关注。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__8" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">这些项目给我最大的收获不是 Star，是人。因为开源，我认识了上万个素未谋面的技术同好。有人帮我修过 Bug，有人凌晨在群里帮陌生人排查问题，有人后来成了我的同事和朋友。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__9" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">在阿里的时候，我作为技术负责人支持过 ATA。说实话，它不是我的 KPI，只是喜欢，所以一直想让他更好。后来，很多同学早上到工位做的第一件事就是打开 ATA看看最新的技术文章，好的分享，后来不仅仅技术人看，很多产品、运营也看ATA。在外网的帖子大家讨论离开阿里后你最怀念的是啥，很多人的答案是 ATA。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__10" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">那时候我就明白了：社区真正的价值，从来不是内容本身，而是内容背后的人。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__11" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">那天咖啡店打烊了，我们还在聊</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__12" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">2023 年我从阿里出来创业，看到了博客园的救园帖。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__13" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">博客园是很多中国程序员的青春：第一篇技术博客发在那里，第一次被人在评论区纠错也在那里。一个陪了大家二十年的社区，走到了需要用户来救的地步。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__14" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">我约了博客园创始人 dudu 见面。那天我们一直聊到晚上十点多，咖啡店关门了，我们还在聊。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__15" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">那次聊天让我觉得，dudu 是一个非常纯粹的技术人。博客园那么难的时候，他也不愿意在文章里塞广告，不愿意卖课割韭菜。他说得很平静，好像这是一件理所当然的事。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__16" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">那天我觉得自己找到了知己。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__17" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">之后三年，我们不停地讨论同一个问题：AI 时代，社区到底应该是什么样？</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__18" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 28px 0 32px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; <section class="js_darkmode__19" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">一个 00 后让我看到了另一种可能</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__20" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">认识仲泰更早。第一次见到这个年轻人，我就觉得他特别有活力，满脑子想法，浑身是冲劲。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__21" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">他做的公众号「特工宇宙」很有意思。后来他又做了「观猹」，一个给 AI 产品写点评的社区。观猹里每一条点评都要真人来写，想成为点评员，要么被邀请，要么考过 50 道题。在什么都能用 AI 批量生成的今天，他偏偏选了最慢、最笨的那条路：要真的。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__22" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">很早以前他就跟我说，他在做一个社区。我当时想，这是一个非常年轻的社区，就像他本人一样，敢想敢干。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__23" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">三代人，一个共同点</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__24" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">从 2023 年开始，我心里一直想做一个社区。但 AI 变化太快，我一直没想清楚：在这个时代，我们到底能给大家什么不一样的价值？</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__25" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">这三年我没有停止探索。直到今年，这个想法终于成熟了。我约dudu、仲泰一起吃了个饭：</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__26" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">“我们一起干一个吧。”</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__27" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">一个 70 后，一个 90 后，一个 00 后，加起来做了快五十年的社区。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__28" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">我们年龄差了两代人，做事风格完全不同。但我们有一个共同点：都在最难的时候选择过对用户好。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__29" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">dudu 在博客园最难的时候没有加广告，我在没有利益的情况下做了10年开源，仲泰在人人都用 AI 刷内容的时候坚持真人点评。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__30" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">不割韭菜，不卖焦虑，不把用户当流量。只做自己每天早上也想打开的东西。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__31" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">AI 能给你答案，但给不了你同路人</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__32" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">想了三年，我们想清楚了这几件事：</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__33" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important"><span class="js_darkmode__34" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">第一，AI 确实能回答大部分问题。</span>&nbsp;写一篇"如何配置 XXX"的教程，以后可能真没人看了。这是事实，我们不回避。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__35" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: bold">第二，人永远需要交流。</span>&nbsp;AI 能告诉你代码怎么写，但"这个方案我们在生产环境踩过坑"、"这个框架别用，半年后你会后悔"、"我也卡在这里三天了，原来不是我一个人"，这些只有人能说。技术人需要讨论，需要争论，需要分享，需要被看见。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__36" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: bold">第三，杂活应该交给 Agent。</span>&nbsp;每天几百条 AI 新闻看不过来，英文论文读起来费劲，关注的开源项目更新了也不知道。这些事不该再消耗人的时间。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__37" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-weight: bold">第四，好观点值得被沉淀。</span>&nbsp;AI 学的是人写下的东西。所以在 AI 时代，有真实经历、有独立判断的人，反而比以前更稀缺。你的观点值得一个长久的家，而不是淹没在信息流里。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__38" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 28px 0 32px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; <section class="js_darkmode__39" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">所以我们做了 ReadmeX：一个 AI 时代的新社区，让人、知识和 Agent 更好地协作。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__40" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">在这里：</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__41" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">每天的 AI 头条由 Agent 替你看完国内外上百个信源，筛出真正值得看的，中英双语，一分钟看完一天。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__42" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">社区讨论只留给真人。 你可以提问、分享实践、争论观点，Agent 负责整理背景，人负责交流。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__43" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">GitHub 项目有自己的社区。 你关注的开源项目，动态自动同步，作者和用户在同一个地方交流。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__44" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">社区还能被你的 AI 工具直接使用（通过 MCP），在你自己的工作流里随时调用社区的知识。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__45" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">我们不想用 AI 取代人，我们想让 AI 把人从杂事里解放出来，回到交流本身。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__46" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">为什么是 1024</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__47" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">很多人不知道，最早提议把 10 月 24 日定为中国程序员节的，是博客园上的一篇帖子。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__48" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">后来，1024 成了所有中国程序员的节日。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__49" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">所以我们选在今天发布 ReadmeX。不是为了蹭节日，而是想在这个从博客园诞生的日子，重新出发。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__50" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; font-size: 18px"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(61, 167, 66, 1); font-weight: bold">写给第一批同行者</span></span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__51" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">ReadmeX 首批开放 1024 个创始成员席位。每一位创始成员都会获得一枚带专属编号的永久徽章。编号永不回收，它会一直证明，你是在最早那一天来的。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__52" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">我们用邀请制，不是为了制造稀缺。社区的风气是最早那一千个人定下的。我们希望第一批朋友，是愿意分享、愿意回答陌生人问题的人。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__53" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important">可以加我微信，如果微信报错，可以通过这个链接提交，我会来加你。</span></section>
<section class="js_darkmode__54" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.544px; orphans: 2; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">
<p style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; clear: both; min-height: 1em"><span style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important" data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;,&quot;data-layout-id&quot;:null}]"><a class="normal_text_link" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0; padding: 0; outline: 0; color: rgba(87, 107, 149, 1); text-decoration: none; -webkit-user-drag: none; cursor: default; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important" href="https://readmex.ai/access?lang=zh&amp;apply=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2">https://readmex.ai/access?lang=zh&amp;apply=1</a></span></p>
</section>
<section class="js_darkmode__55" style="-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; outline: 0; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important;
